idea: A mother and her grown son sit in a parked car outside a hospital at dawn. She says: "Your father would have hated this parking lot." He laughs and answers: "He hated every parking lot, Mom."
A detective leans across a metal table toward a silent suspect. He asks "Where were you?", then "Who saw you?", and finally, almost gently, "Why are you lying to me?"

An old violinist tunes her instrument alone in an empty concert hall and speaks to the front row: "I played this song at our wedding, at your funeral, and every Sunday since, and I will keep playing it until these old hands finally forget how it goes."
A night-shift cashier counts a stranger's coins under buzzing lights and sighs: "It's $4.50, it's 3:15 a.m., and we've been open 24/7 since 1987."
A hotel receptionist covers the phone and calls across the lobby: "Siobhán, tell Zoë that Mr. Nguyễn is waiting downstairs."
A man opens a shoebox of old letters in his late wife's closet and freezes: "Wait... you kept them — all of them? Every single one!"
A teenage girl reads a crumpled note from her dad's coat pocket out loud: "He wrote 'don't wait for me' and then he waited anyway."
A drama teacher stops the rehearsal and says: "When I say "stop," you stop. Not "in a minute." Now."
Бабуся стоїть біля вікна на кухні й дивиться на засніжену дорогу. Вона тихо каже: "Я чекала на тебе цілу зиму."
A soldier on leave steps off a night train in Lviv and calls his mother from the platform: "Мамо, я вдома. I'm home."
A fat orange cat sits on a windowsill, turns slowly to the camera and says: "You're late again, human."
A rusty delivery robot waits alone at a crosswalk in the rain and announces: "Battery at 3%. Still waiting for you."
A seven-year-old girl in pajamas lies on the roof of a farmhouse next to her grandfather and asks: "Grandpa, why do the stars blink?"
In the rain, a woman leans on a shovel beside freshly turned earth at the edge of a forest. She wipes her face and says: "Nobody will ever find you here."
Loneliness in a big city.
A babysitter hides in a dark pantry with a phone pressed to her ear: "[whispers] They're still in the house."
A nervous intern bursts into the lab holding a phone: "Dr. Patel, NASA and the FBI are on line two 🚀"
A bride stands at the altar, looks at the groom for a long moment, and says: "No."
A poker player turns over a losing hand, leans back and grins at the dealer: "You actually believed me? [laughs]"

1 кадр: маленька дівчина в червоному плащі відчиняє величезні двері старого замку. 2 кадр: вона заходить у величезну бальну залу, зала видна вся, дівчина маленька на її фоні, і каже: "Hello? Is anyone still here?"

Shot 1: a knight in a crimson cloak rides through a stormy valley toward a black castle. Shot 2: he dismounts at the iron gate. Shot 3: he looks up at a single lit tower window. Shot 4: he calls up to the window: "I came back for you."
A tiny figure on a cliff above a stormy sea shouts into the wind: "I am not afraid of you anymore!"
